findingDetails.title: Three acceptance rows state final-tree suite counts the tree no longer has
findingDetails.scopeProof: The acceptance file is in review-scope-files.txt and the counts are checked against the fixture and AC-028 in the same document.
findingDetails.claim: AC-009, AC-030 and AC-037 cite 841 tests and 359 fixture cases as final-tree evidence while the fixture holds 368 cases and AC-028 records 187 files and 3,557 passed.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Read AC-028 and the implementation summary thirteenth-round rows to see whether 359 is the final count; both say 368. Checked whether the 841 figure belongs to a dated round; the cells say on the final tree, not in a round.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The cells were written in the eleventh round and never updated, while the row that owns the final counts was updated; the Met status still rests on other rows that do hold.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If a later round re-ran the two files and the Python suite and recorded 841 and 359 for that round, the cells are dated rather than stale.

results.summary: 122 tasks and 67 AC rows checked; the tails resolve (problems=0) and the CHK counts match; R5-P2-001 leaves three Met rows on stale final-tree counts.
The attachCommand() paragraph carries R3-P2-001; the remaining hub-side statements are read in iteration 6.

noveltyJustification: One new P2 on closure counts; the task and AC sweep otherwise confirmed the recorded evidence.
